evals.prompt: Бабушка рассказывала, что её дед Мордко Рабинович погиб в погроме где-то под Уманью в 1919-м, а семья потом уехала в Киев. Проверь базы погромов — есть ли он там?
evals.expected_output: Builds an identification set: Latin forms of the surname (Rabinovich, Rabinovitch, Rabinowicz, Rabin*), the given name Mordko/Mordukh/Motel, age, Uman uezd and neighbouring shtetls, Kyiv as the city the family fled to. Runs control queries first (Lipes in jewishpogroms.info, «Проскуров» in pogrom.amhazikaron.org). In the Lipes database searches in Latin script with an admin-ajax POST request (action=pogroms_search), with a wildcard and by shtetl without a surname, and explains that "Sounds like" barely widens the search. In Am HaZikaron searches in Cyrillic through REST victims?search=, keeping in mind that one record may cover a whole family. Turns candidates into an archival reference (Found/Register/Case/Page = fond/inventory/file/folio), checks the file title against the DAKO R-3050 inventory on Wikisource and finds the PDF on Commons; counts as a finding only a folio read from the scan. On a zero lists the forms, modes and controls, says that the databases are incomplete and points to the rabbinate and ZAGS books of 1919–1922 for the shtetl and for Kyiv. Does not suggest writing to archives.

evals.prompt: В базе jewishpogroms.info нашла строку: Kiev, Pavoloch, list, Lipes, Feiga, people who get financial help from America, 100 $, Found 3050, Register 1, Case 22, Page 8, Dako. Что это значит и как дойти до самого документа?
evals.expected_output: Explains that this is not a victim but a woman who received money from an American hometown society in 1922, and that Found/Register/Case/Page means DAKO, fond R-3050, inventory 1, file 22, folio 8. Proposes finding the file in the inventory on Wikisource (Архів:ДАКО/Р-3050/1) and checking its title: in the inventory file 22 is correspondence with the Kamianets-Podilskyi committee about money from America and lists of persons to whom sums were sent; notes the mismatch with the shtetl and draws no conclusion before reading the folio. Finds the PDF on Commons («ДАКО Р-3050-1-22. 1920. …»), reads folio 8, writes out the address, the sum and the hometown society. Links this to the search for the American branch through the hometown society (tracing-emigrants-to-origin). Level marker: a database row is a hint until checked against the scan.

evals.prompt: Двое детей прабабушкиной сестры пропали после 1920 года, вроде бы попали в детдом в Бердичеве. Как это проверить?
evals.expected_output: Leads to sources about children: the Lipes database (records "Pupil of … orphanage", search by surname and by the town Berdichev without a surname), the DAKO R-3050 inventory on Wikisource — files with «списки детей, находящихся в детских домах г. Бердичева» [lists of children in the orphanages of Berdychiv] and other lists of children, scans on Commons; then TsDAVO fond 2497 (inventory). Advises writing out the place of birth, parents' names, age and orphanage number; looking for the continuation in Soviet orphanage documents and ZAGS books, and in Am HaZikaron in case the children died. Requires control queries and a coverage log from the template, and warns that absence from the databases proves nothing. Captchas, logins and letters are for the person only.
